rows.feature: Inventory of agents across the organization in the Agent Registry
Basic governance actions on agents (publish, deploy, block, delete, approve; assign agents to specific user/groups; reassign agent owner, pin, etc.)
Automate agent lifecycle actions using conditions-based rules
Synchronize agents and agent metadata from external platforms that aren’t managed by Agent 365 into the registry
Policy templates applying customized policies and controls to agents
Observability and monitoring of agent activity (Visualization and telemetry)
Control which tools (including Microsoft MCP servers) agents can access tenant-wide
Graph API provides access to agent registry, basic metadata, and governance actions
Access packages for agents to define scope of agent permissions
Built‑in Entra lifecycle policies automate sponsor‑driven workflows to maintain accountability
Conditional access and identity protection for agents (for agents with delegated access - extend user policies to agents)
Monitor and block malicious and noncompliant network traffic for agents, operating on user devices, and for Copilot Studio agents​
Audit logs of agent activities and eDiscovery (content search) of agent interaction to export and hold for legal, regulatory, and investigative needs
Data Lifecycle Management for agent-generated data and interactions in line with regulations and org policies
Detect and review noncompliant agent interactions; extend compliance manager to agents to assess, manage, and demonstrate AI compliance
Data Security Posture Management with AI Observability provides deep interaction visibility for agents
Extend Insider Risk Management to agents – detect anomalous and risky agent activities
Agents inherit and honor data sensitivity labels
Data loss prevention – block agents from accessing and sharing sensitive content
Sync shadow AI endpoint agents
Identify and remediate agent misconfigurations and exposure risks, relationship mapping for local agents (agent to devices, MCPs, etc.)
Detect suspicious agent activity, receive alerts, and allow blocking for tool invocations for agents
Collect Agent 365 unified agent observability logs and allow investigation and hunting for threats for agents
Device compliance for agent conditional access
Policy-controlled environment for agents runtime
Block unsanctioned local endpoint agents
